mainEntity.name: What are the estimated costs for tiny home permits?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit costs for tiny homes typically include application fees, plan check fees, and various impact fees, which can vary widely depending on the city and the scope of the project. These fees contribute to services like planning, building, fire, and public works. For an ADU-classified tiny home in San Diego County, total permit fees could range from a few thousand dollars to upwards of $10,000 or more, not including architectural or engineering design costs. Some jurisdictions may waive or reduce certain impact fees for smaller ADUs. It is essential to get an itemized estimate from your local building department.
acceptedAnswer.description: Estimated permit costs for tiny homes can range from a few thousand dollars to over $10,000, covering application, plan check, and impact fees, varying by jurisdiction and project scope.
